_about: Resolutions for the things the Angrakha Maxi text under-determines.
Every entry cites where the answer came from. This file is the human-in-
the-loop artefact: the normalizer reports an open question, someone reads
the figure once, and the document compiles deterministically from then on.
Anything the figures do NOT settle is deliberately absent, so it keeps
showing up in the report as an open question.
Inserted rows carry fractional step_index values so they sort into place.

insert.why: Figure page2_back_block2 labels G on the centre-back line at the arm-depth level, i.e. level with F. No sentence defines it, but step 7 measures from it.

row.notes: figure-derived: centre back at arm-depth height
row.raw_text: G -> where the arm depth line meets the centre back

insert.why: The bottom-part text lists only the changes; figure page2_bottom shows the rectangle A-B-C-D it starts from. A is its top-left corner.

row.notes: figure-derived: top-left corner of the gore block

insert.why: Figure page2_bottom: A-B is the top edge of the gore block. Combining 'C-D = (A-B) x flare' with 'A-B = C-D' only resolves if the block width is the finished gore width times the flare multiplier.

row.notes: figure-derived: block width = gore width x flare
row.raw_text: A - B -> gore width x flare

back:3.why: page1_back_block1: C1 sits directly below C. A shoulder slope is always dropped square from the shoulder-width point.

back:5.why: page2/page3: E is drawn at the outer end of the shoulder line, not on the centre back. 'Reducted shoulder value' is a length measured along A-C1.

back:8.why: page2_back_block2: H1 is marked to the right of H, i.e. outward from centre back.

back:9.why: page3_back_block3: E1 is the 1-inch corner cross, drawn up-and-right from F at 45 degrees.

back:12.why: Same allowance restated under the next figure.

bottom:2.why: Mis-extraction. raw_text is 'C - D -> (A - B) x 2,3 or 4' but the row records output D from B with a vertical direction. C-D is the bottom edge of the block, already fixed by A-B; the flare multiplier is applied there instead.

back:6.5.why: Bearing is unused: the inserted G step crosses x-from-A with y-from-F (direction 'cross').
